title: Minimum Records
statementMd:
VegiCat has n closed integer intervals [l1,r1],[l2,r2],…,[ln,rn].

He wants to construct a sequence a1,a2,…,an by choosing an integer ai from each interval [li,ri]. That is, li≤ai≤ri for every 1≤i≤n.

A position i is called a **record position** if ai>aj for every 1≤j<i. In particular, position 1 is always a record position.

Help VegiCat minimize the number of record positions. Output this minimum number.

## Input

The first line contains an integer T (1≤T≤104), the number of test cases. The description of the test cases follows.

The first line of each test case contains an integer n (1≤n≤106), the number of intervals.

The i-th of the next n lines contains two integers li,ri (−109≤li≤ri≤109), describing the interval available at position i.

It is guaranteed that the sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 106.

## Output

For each test case, output an integer — the minimum possible number of record positions.

## Note

In the first test case, one optimal sequence is a=[1,100,20,30]. Its record positions are 1 and 2.

In the second test case, one optimal sequence is a=[−1,4,1,2,8,6,12,12]. Its record positions are 1, 2, 5, and 7. Position 8 is not a record because its value equals the maximum seen so far.
